segments.text: A Universal Federation Army Commander. A senior investigator belonging to the army military police investigation department. A beautiful woman commissioned officer who has a lovely, calm, cool, and collected judgment. She is a New Solar, being born on Planet Titan. She is heading an investigation regarding the unlawful activities being conducted by the Neo Terrors' politicians. Having witnessed the cesspools the Neo Terrors have covered with injustice and corruption, it is her conviction that the only way to peace in the galaxy is through getting the New Solars fired up with justice and an ideal by exposing the Neo Terrors' injustice again and again. She has become popular with the New Solars' citizens from those achievements and her lovely features, the New Solars' reasons being praised extravagantly due to her.
From Dark Translations
ニュー・ソラル派の宇宙連邦軍中佐。
軍憲兵捜査部所属の上級捜査官。
沈着冷静な判断力と美貌の持ち主。
ネオ・テラーズ派を悪の巣窟であると憚らず、宇宙の恒久的な平和は健全なるニュー・ソラル派によってのみ成し遂げられると信じて疑わず、これまで数々のネオ・テラーズ派の不正を暴いてきた。
そのためニュー・ソラル派からは絶大な支持を得ているが、逆にネオ・テラーズ派からは憎悪の対象となっている。

美しさと冷静沈着な判断力をもった美女将校。
惑星タイタン出身のニュー・ソラル派。
ネオ・テラーズ派の大物政治家が主導している非合法活動について調査している。
汚職や不正に塗れたネオ・テラーズ派を悪の巣窟と見ている。
理想と正義に燃えるニュー・ソラル派によってしか銀河は平和にならないとという信念のもと、数々のネオ・テラーズ派の不正を暴いてきた。
その実績と美しい容貌からニュー・ソラル派市民に人気が高く、ニュー・ソラルの理性と持て囃されている。

A Universal Federation Army Major. A New Solar born on Planet Titan. Naomi Evans is an aide to the investigators in the army military police investigation department. Learning to operate the self-propelled robot soldier called the "Gun Turtle" is said to be extremely difficult, but Naomi is able to operate as many as 4 at once. Excelling in close combat herself as well, she has won two championships in Titan's hand-to-hand tournaments. Originally, she was the eldest daughter of the mercantile house associating with House Bishop, but because of her time spent as a child with Lieri, she walked the path of military personnel in the steps of Lieri. Naturally, with going to the same government school as Lieri, Lieri has become more than just Naomi's senior officer, thinking of each other as true sisters. Because of Lieri's influence on her, she considers the savage, mass ideologies of the Neo Terrors, antiquated. Again, because of her superiority, she often attracts trouble from the male soldiers who look down on her as being bossy and arrogant.

軍憲兵捜査部所属の捜査官で、リエリの副官を務めている。
宇宙連邦軍の陸戦部隊に正式採用されている自走ロボット兵“ガンタートル”を4機同時に操れる天才。
また格闘術にも優れ、惑星タイタンで開催される格闘大会で二度優勝した経験を持つ。
幼い頃からリエリと行動を共にしていた彼女は、憧れていたリエリの後を追うように軍職に就く。
彼女自身、優秀であるが故に、自分よりも劣る男を蔑み、馬鹿にする傾向にある。
また、リエリの影響でネオ・テラーズ派を良く思っていない。

A third-year student at the Rinin Academy.
Daughter of Aiko Katsuragi. Second daughter.

She belongs to the swimming club. If her older sister is a kind older sister, she is a beautiful younger sister. She has a kind and cheerful personality, and is able to interact with everyone without distinction.
She is treated like an idol by the main character, Motoko Tamura, Izumi Shinohara, and other close childhood friends.
She is troubled by family problems, such as constant quarrels between her father and mother.

A female teacher who teaches English at the Rinin Academy.
A married woman. She has just married Tomonobu Nakamura, a physical education teacher at her workplace.

She is the most popular among the female teachers because of her innocent demeanor but glamorous body, which is inherited from her mother, and her mild and gentle personality. Many male faculty members and students lament her marriage. She lives with her husband in an apartment for newlyweds a few minutes away from Katsuragi Clinic.
She has known Suzuko Yamazaki for a long time and they are close as senior and junior. She is a good friend of Suzuko Yamazaki, who appears to be cold at first glance to her.

Her parents died in an accident two years ago, and she now lives with her younger brother. She was originally from a wealthy family and thanks to her parents' insurance money, she is not in financial trouble.
Her father, Takayuki Yukimi, is Toshio Katsuragi's older brother, and Katsuragi and his wife sometimes invite them over for dinner and take care of them.

She is not at all unsympathetic toward his younger brother, who is her only living close relative after the death of his parents, but she avoids him at school because she is worried that her classmates will see his otaku-like appearance.
She is a member of a group of close childhood friends.

She is a first-year student at Rinin Academy.
Tomomi is known as one of the most beautiful girls in the school.

She is an all-around athlete and was chosen as an athlete for the women's gymnastics team, and her outstanding appearance has even led her to be featured in an idol magazine despite her being an athlete.
She has recently started dating a student named Tagami.
He is also good-looking and belongs to the baseball team, and is the kind of person who gets cheered at the regional qualifying rounds.
So, with the help of her older brother Satoshi, who is also a member of the baseball team, Tomomi chooses an out-of-the-way place in the school and has a series of small dates with him.

そこで知美は同じ野球部に所属している兄・聡の協力を得て、学園のひと気のないところを選んではささやかなデートを重ねている。

As a Universal Federation Army Major, he is captain of the battleship Jasant in charge of transporting key figures. However, his hidden persona is as a special spy working for the Neo Terrors and an illegal agent who accomplishes his missions through sabotage and assassination. He also has an interest in acquiring fame for himself; he has no political attachments and has no interest in the Neo Terrors and New Solars getting along, but from his point of view upon hearing the hypocrisy of the New Solars, he does have a firm attachment to the more human Neo Terrors and their corrupt ways. Donny's interest is in human brainwashing techniques by means of memory implants using brainwashing devices, that, he thinks, will be useful in propelling his rise to fame. As for his ideas, he carries out his methods like a mad man, unfearing too of god when he creates completely new and artificial personalities. In the past, he had an experience of being imprisoned upon making a mistake in his mission relating to Lieri and Naomi, and after being released from prison, he has planned a sequence of events in determined revenge against those two people by altering their personalities.
from Dark Translations
